card.name: Future 'will' in opinion essays
card.fires_on: The word 'will' (and nearby words like 'not', 'to', 'out') in persuasive or op-ed prose, usually after a general subject such as 'Customers', 'there' or 'so'. It also fires on repeated parallel phrases.

modes.label: 'will' after a subject
modes.description: The future-tense 'will' after a general subject in a statement about what people or society will do.
modes.example: Customers<< will>> most value our businesses when their needs are

modes.label: Parallel phrase repeats
modes.description: A word that repeats a structure from earlier in the sentence, such as 'out-' or 'right'.
modes.example: out-educate and<< out>>-build the rest of the world

card.plain: It marks the spot in opinion writing where a sentence predicts what will happen or repeats a parallel phrase.
